### [The Ruler Matters: Factor Exposures, Attribution, and Portfolio Risk](/research/the-ruler-matters.qmd)

When an investor hedges a value, momentum or size tilt with a factor model, which positions do the model's loadings represent, and how do the stocks, trading and risk required depend on the ruler that measures exposure?

[Mingyang Liu]{.authors}
